description: This Java source file defines the EngineSnifferPanel class, which is part of the user interface for a engine diagnostics and analysis application. It manages a set of graphical components, including images representing engine signals, controls for zoom and pause, and handles display of engine charts and reports. The class interacts with other modules like engine state, chart parsing, and external links, providing visualization and user interaction functionalities for real-time engine data monitoring.
external_files: com/rusefi/ui/.* (including UpDownImage, UiUtils, RpmLabel, AnyCommand, etc.)
